Container.Name: npm-crowd-dash
Container.Overview: A small dashboard that shows CrowdSec bans (and AppSec/WAF blocks) - IP, reason/scenario, source, country/AS, time issued, expiry - without having to run "cscli decision list" or dig through the CrowdSec console.
Container.Description:
Polls CrowdSec's own LAPI directly (/v1/decisions/stream + /v1/alerts), keeps a local history in SQLite (CrowdSec forgets a decision once it expires - this doesn't), and serves an auto-refreshing table via FastAPI + HTMX (single container, no JS build step).
Setup: - On the CrowdSec container, run "cscli bouncers add dashboard-reader" for a bouncer key, and "cscli machines add dashboard-reader --auto" for a machine account - Fill in the CrowdSec LAPI URL (LAN IP, not 127.0.0.1, if CrowdSec runs in its own container) and the credentials above into the variables below

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on.

Config.Name: CrowdSec LAPI URL
Config.Description: LAN URL of the CrowdSec LAPI, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8301

Config.Name: Poll Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often the LAPI is polled.

Config.Name: Retention (days)
Config.Description: How long expired decisions are kept in history.

Config.Name: Repeat Offender Threshold
Config.Description: Number of bans before an IP is flagged as a repeat offender.

Config.Name: Country Ban Threshold
Config.Description: Number of bans before a country is flagged.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Used by the Reports page to send an abuse report you've reviewed there. Nothing is emailed automatically.

Config.Name: SMTP User
Config.Description: Used by the Reports page to send an abuse report you've reviewed there.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: Used by the Reports page to send an abuse report you've reviewed there.

Config.Name: SMTP From
Config.Description: Sender address for abuse reports sent from the Reports page.

Config.Name: Settings Secret Key
Config.Description: Required to save an SMTP password via the Settings page. Leave blank and the dashboard still runs normally, but no new SMTP password can be saved until this is set (no auto-generated fallback). Generate with: python3 -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"
